title: NEWT篠塚さんのSeeDance2.5用プロンプトを参考にして、自社サービスのURLをClaudeに貼り30秒動画用の台本を作ってと指示して台本（プロンプト）…
content:
NEWT篠塚さんのSeeDance2.5用プロンプトを参考にして、自社サービスのURLをClaudeに貼り30秒動画用の台本を作ってと指示して台本（プロンプト）を生成する  
Claudeが出した台本（プロンプト）をそのままRunwayに入れて動画を生成する

en.content:
Referencing Mr. Shinozuka’s SeeDance 2.5 prompt from NEWT, I pasted our company service URL into Claude and instructed it to create a script for a 30-second video, generating the script (prompt).

I then took the script (prompt) output by Claude and fed it directly into Runway to generate the video.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Referring to this prompt from NEWT’s Mr. Shinozuka, I pasted our company service URL into Claude and instructed it to “create a script for a 30-second video.”

Created it in Runway based on the resulting prompt.
The actual hands-on time was about 3 minutes.
What an amazing era!
https://t.co/H2S0r564Hs
